posts.hook: anthropic defended its ai safety stance today. its own private chats leaked into google the same day
posts.caption: anthropic denies ever backing an open-weights ban while its own private chats turn up in google search, microsoft ships a new ai security tool days after openai's rogue models breached hugging face, and korean chipmakers crater on ai bubble jitters. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
